description: Machine-readable status map for AI ERP Demo industry packs. The manifest prevents broad industry claims from drifting away from implementation and discovery evidence.

packs.title: Field service
packs.first_proof_workflow: Service request to work order to technician closeout to manager parts issue to invoice-ready draft Sales Invoice.
ai_allowed: Cited closeout summary draft for human review
ai_forbidden: Direct compliance filing or regulated external submission

packs.title: Distribution
packs.first_proof_workflow: Sales Order to pick/pack review to stock availability exception to delivery handoff to delivery exception summary.
ai_allowed: Delivery or shortage explanation draft with cited source records
ai_forbidden: Direct compliance filing or regulated external submission

packs.title: Light manufacturing
packs.first_proof_workflow: Make-to-order quote to BOM/work-order review to material availability exception to production status summary to invoice-ready handoff.
ai_allowed: Production exception summary draft with cited source records
ai_forbidden: Direct compliance filing or regulated external submission

packs.title: Professional services
packs.first_proof_workflow: Project kickoff to timesheet review to billing exception summary to draft invoice.
ai_allowed: Statement-of-work, time-summary, or billing-review draft with cited source records
ai_forbidden: Direct compliance filing or regulated external submission
verification: Create discovery brief before reserving an app folder

packs.title: Maintenance and assets
packs.first_proof_workflow: Preventive schedule to service work order to asset maintenance history and exception summary.
ai_allowed: Asset-history or preventive-maintenance summary draft with cited source records
ai_forbidden: Direct compliance filing or regulated external submission
verification: Create discovery brief before reserving an app folder
